  "descriptionPlain": "Who We Are\nVerkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.\nWe’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.\nThe Opportunity\nEvery day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.\nAccess control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.\nWe are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.\nWe do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. You will work with a dedicated designer, an engineering manager, and a dedicated engineering team.\nWe are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.\nThe access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right\nOwn users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it\nOwn the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors\nOwn visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired\nProvisioning and integrations: let the system run itself\nOwn the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI\nPartner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does\nAgents and natural language: let admins state intent\nDefine how agents fit into access management. An admin should be able to say what they want and have the system propose the configuration that satisfies it\nDefine the guardrails. Anything that changes who can open a physical door needs review, attribution, and a clean path to undo\nBuild the evaluation framework: accuracy, escalation rate, and how we know a proposed change is safe before it ships to a door\nSecurity posture: surface what looks wrong before it becomes an incident\nBuild the proactive layer: over-provisioned users, credentials that outlived their purpose, access patterns that do not match a door's sensitivity\nOwn audit and compliance reporting, including what a customer hands an auditor to prove who had access to what, and when\nDirection\nSet the direction for access management over multiple years, not just the next few releases, and make the case for it to engineering leadership and the exec team\nBecome the person at Verkada who understands access administrators best. You will define the personas and jobs to be done for this area and make that framework something the rest of the org uses\nRaise the bar for the product managers around you. You will work alongside four other PMs in access control, and we expect your standards for research, writing, and decision-making to show up in their work too\nHow You'll Work\nOwn customer discovery. Talk to security administrators directly, go on site walks, and watch someone badge through a building to see where the model breaks down in the real world\nSet strategy and prioritize the roadmap, balancing reliability, new capability, and the loudest customer in the room\nPrototype constantly. We expect you to build things to think, not only to write specs about them. You will do this in the interview process too\nPartner closely with engineering and design, bringing both technical depth and design sense\nDrive execution from spec to launch with obsessive attention to detail\nCraft the product pitch with marketing and sales, and help the field sell a capability that is often the reason a deal closes\nStay on top of the competitive landscape, the identity ecosystem, and where the market is going\nHold several time horizons at once: learning from customers now, planning six and twelve months out, and shipping what launches next quarter\nWhat you'll bring\n6+ years of product management experience, currently at Senior or Lead scope. You have owned a product area, not a single feature, and you set its direction rather than executing someone else's\nExperience with B2B software used by administrators at scale. with a track record of building and scaling complex enterprise products. Permissions, identity, provisioning, policy, or configuration-heavy admin tooling is directly relevant, as is any product where one person's settings decide what thousands of other people can do\nA real design partnership. You write problem briefs rather than solutions, you can say why a design is good and not just whether you like it, and you have changed a designer's mind and had yours changed\nComfort going deep with engineers on architecture and tradeoffs, then explaining them clearly to customers and executives\nA standing customer cadence you own, not research handed to you. You can point to a time a customer insight reversed a plan you had already made\nExplicit prioritization. You can walk through a real sequencing decision: the criteria you used, what you consciously dropped, and who was unhappy about it\nYou enjoy envisioning the big picture and managing the details\nStrong written and verbal communication. You lead with the recommendation, make the tradeoff explicit, and keep it short enough that people actually read it\nYou like getting your hands dirty and getting out in the field to understand customer pain points\nEmployee Benefits\nVerkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:\nHealthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans\nNationwide medical, vision and dental coverage\nStarting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary\nHealth Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options\nExpanded mental health support\nPaid parental leave policy & fertility benefits\nTime off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time\nProfessional development stipend\nWellness/fitness benefits\nHealthy lunches provided daily\nCommuter benefits\nAdditional Information:\nWe do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.\nAnnual Pay Range\nAt Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)\nBelow is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).\nEstimated Annual Pay Range\n$205,000—$240,000 USD\nVerkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer\nAs an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.\nYour application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy."

posting.descriptionPlain:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
The Opportunity
Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.
Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.
We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.
We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. You will work with a dedicated designer, an engineering manager, and a dedicated engineering team.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.
The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right
Own users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it
Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors
Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired
Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself
Own the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI
Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does
Agents and natural language: let admins state intent
Define how agents fit into access management. An admin should be able to say what they want and have the system propose the configuration that satisfies it
Define the guardrails. Anything that changes who can open a physical door needs review, attribution, and a clean path to undo
Build the evaluation framework: accuracy, escalation rate, and how we know a proposed change is safe before it ships to a door
Security posture: surface what looks wrong before it becomes an incident
Build the proactive layer: over-provisioned users, credentials that outlived their purpose, access patterns that do not match a door's sensitivity
Own audit and compliance reporting, including what a customer hands an auditor to prove who had access to what, and when
Direction
Set the direction for access management over multiple years, not just the next few releases, and make the case for it to engineering leadership and the exec team
Become the person at Verkada who understands access administrators best. You will define the personas and jobs to be done for this area and make that framework something the rest of the org uses
Raise the bar for the product managers around you. You will work alongside four other PMs in access control, and we expect your standards for research, writing, and decision-making to show up in their work too
How You'll Work
Own customer discovery. Talk to security administrators directly, go on site walks, and watch someone badge through a building to see where the model breaks down in the real world
Set strategy and prioritize the roadmap, balancing reliability, new capability, and the loudest customer in the room
Prototype constantly. We expect you to build things to think, not only to write specs about them. You will do this in the interview process too
Partner closely with engineering and design, bringing both technical depth and design sense
Drive execution from spec to launch with obsessive attention to detail
Craft the product pitch with marketing and sales, and help the field sell a capability that is often the reason a deal closes
Stay on top of the competitive landscape, the identity ecosystem, and where the market is going
Hold several time horizons at once: learning from customers now, planning six and twelve months out, and shipping what launches next quarter
What you'll bring
6+ years of product management experience, currently at Senior or Lead scope. You have owned a product area, not a single feature, and you set its direction rather than executing someone else's
Experience with B2B software used by administrators at scale. with a track record of building and scaling complex enterprise products. Permissions, identity, provisioning, policy, or configuration-heavy admin tooling is directly relevant, as is any product where one person's settings decide what thousands of other people can do
A real design partnership. You write problem briefs rather than solutions, you can say why a design is good and not just whether you like it, and you have changed a designer's mind and had yours changed
Comfort going deep with engineers on architecture and tradeoffs, then explaining them clearly to customers and executives
A standing customer cadence you own, not research handed to you. You can point to a time a customer insight reversed a plan you had already made
Explicit prioritization. You can walk through a real sequencing decision: the criteria you used, what you consciously dropped, and who was unhappy about it
You enjoy envisioning the big picture and managing the details
Strong written and verbal communication. You lead with the recommendation, make the tradeoff explicit, and keep it short enough that people actually read it
You like getting your hands dirty and getting out in the field to understand customer pain points
Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

Commuter benefits

We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity.
